outline:
先修課程：負責教授同意
一維系統的自由及強制振動
多維系統的自由及強制振動
自然頻率的計算與模態分析
振動的控制
振動量測與應用
振動系統之數值分析方法
非線性振動
機構與動力傳動元件的振動分析
schedule:
週次  進度
1.  Basic concepts of vibration.
2   Free and forced vibrations of single degree of freedom systems.
3   Free and forced vibrations of single degree of freedom systems.
4   Free and forced vibrations of single degree of freedom systems.
5   Free and forced vibrations of multi-degree of freedom systems.
6   Free and forced vibrations of multi-degree of freedom systems.
7   Determination of natural frequencies and mode shapes.
8   Free and forced vibrations of multi-degree of freedom systems.
9   期中考
10  Free and forced vibrations of multi-degree of freedom systems.
11  Continuous systems: string, rod.
12  Continuous systems. beam plate.
13  Vibration measurement and applications.
14  Vibration measurement and applications.
15  Numerical methods in vibration analysis.
16  Numerical methods in vibration analysis.
17  Application of CAE package.
18  期末考
assessment:
1.	Homework 10%
2.	4~5 examination 60%
3.	final examination and/or term paper 30%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

使用外文原文書：

Text:
Singiresu S. Rao
Mechanical Vibrations
3rd / 4th ed. (台北圖書代理?)

Refs:
1.	Leonard Meirovitch, fundamental of vibrations
2.	W. T. Thomson, Theory of Vibration with Applications
3.	Tes, Morse, Hinkle, Mechanical Vibration
4.	Balachandran Magrab, Vibrations
5.	Leonard Meirovitch, Analytical Methods in Vibrations
6.	王栢村，振動學，全華

Prerequisites:
1.	Calculus
2.	Dynamics
3.	Material mechanics.
4.	Engineering mathematics: ODE, Matrix, LT, FT, Complex, PDE.
5.	Computer language: Matlab, Mathematica, Mathcad, Fortran, etc.
